channel.title: NoneNote
channel.description: Sticky notes that live at the edge of your screen.

item.description:
chore: stop hardcoding the version, drop the dead Pages workflow, bump actions

build.sh, make-dmg.sh and release-macos.sh each defaulted to a literal 1.3.1,
so bumping Info.plist alone silently produced a bundle named after the old
version. They read CFBundleShortVersionString from Info.plist instead, which
is the one place the version is declared.

pages.yml could never run — it needs site/, which the fork excluded — and it
rewrote upstream's vercel host into aimen08.github.io/noty. Removed rather
than left as a trap.

Actions that still ran on Node 20 are moved to their current majors. Note
upload-artifact@v5 is still node20; v7 is the first that is not.
